 Boruto and Kawaki’s iconic face-off from the Naruto franchise has returned with a brand-new trailer ahead of a major release.

 Follow on Google Discover 
 Naruto Mobile has released a new trailer for Kawaki, who will be joining the game’s roster as an A-Rank character on Nov. 6. The animation features the fight between Boruto, who is possessed by Momoshiki, and Kawaki, who has awakened his karma. Titled "Kawaki (Karma II)," the game’s variant is based on the second Karma form awakening of Kawaki, complete with his horn and the markings of the seal on his left arm.
 The latest video uses CGI animation to recreate the fight between the two characters and shows Kawaki’s conviction to protect Naruto, even if it means killing Boruto . Yuma Uchida has returned to voice Kawaki’s lines in the video, with Daisuke Namikawa voicing Borushiki.
 Kawaki Unleashes His Second Karma Form in Naruto Mobile on November 6
 The character trailer draws inspiration from the clash between Kawaki and Borushiki in Chapter 66 of Boruto: Naruto Next Generations . Following Isshiki’s defeat, Kawaki is shown reactivating his Karma seal again, granting him full access to the fallen Otsutsuki's abilities, including the Daikokuten, which is featured in the trailer.
 With the power of Karma now under his control, Kawaki unleashed it to stop Borushiki, who was set on eliminating Naruto. In addition to the animated trailer, a theme song video for Kawaki (Karma II) has also been released.
 Kawaki is joining the game’s roster in the November High-Tier recruitment pool as a new playable A-rank unit. Players can unlock the character by collecting 40 character fragments using recruitment scrolls or in-game Gold.
 Developed by Tencent’s Morefun Studios and Bandai Namco Entertainment, Naruto Mobile remains one of the most successful games in the franchise, despite being available exclusively in China. However, this exclusivity may end soon, as the title is receiving an international release as part of the broader projects planned for the Naruto anime’s 25th anniversary .
 New Trailer Comes as Fans Wait for the Boruto Anime to Return
 Boruto At Center Overlayed on Classic Naruto Background with Uzumaki Symbol Image via CBR 
 The Kawaki vs. Boruto video comes as fans of the franchise continue to wait for updates regarding Boruto anime’s return. The anime adaptation went on an indefinite hiatus in March 2023 in order to allow the source material to progress , allowing its adaptation to cut down on filler.
 While any upcoming continuation is expected to adapt the Boruto: Two Blue Vortex sequel manga, Studio Pierrot has remained tight-lipped regarding the anime’s production schedule. While the wait for Boruto anime continues, the long-delayed Naruto anniversary episodes were finally announced.
 The four-episode series, featuring the original Team 7 members, has been confirmed as part of the anime’s 25th anniversary pipeline and will be a crossover with Ninku . In addition to the new anime, Naruto is also getting a manga written by creator Masashi Kishimoto himself and focusing on the Blank Period of the original storyline.
